{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display the first few rows
print(sales_df.head())

# Display basic info
print(sales_df.info())

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()
print("Missing values:\n", missing_values)

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()
print("Number of duplicate rows:", duplicates)

# Check unique values in key columns
print("\nUnique values in 'customer_type':", sales_df['customer_type'].unique())
print("Unique values in 'converted':", sales_df['converted'].unique())

# Show value counts for customer_type
print("\nValue counts for 'customer_type':\n", sales_df['customer_type'].value_counts())

# Show value counts for converted
print("\nValue counts for 'converted':\n", sales_df['converted'].value_counts())"}
